subject.auditScope: Local fixture review of public oversight claims against available governance evidence.

executiveSummary: Available fixture inputs identify potential governance theater signals and evidence gaps. Public-facing statements reference human oversight and audit-ready controls, but the supplied evidence does not demonstrate stop authority, runtime binding, or receipt integrity for the reviewed workflow.

findings.title: Stop authority not demonstrated
findings.summary: Available evidence does not identify who can stop the agentic workflow before execution.
findings.observation: The public claim references human oversight, but the supplied fixture does not identify a role with explicit stop, pause, reject, or escalation authority.
findings.whyItMatters: Agentic governance needs an identified authority able to halt action when risk, scope, or evidence is unclear.
auditQuestions: Who has explicit authority to stop this workflow before execution?
Is stop authority documented separately from general approval authority?
recommendedRemediations: Define stop authority by workflow, risk tier, and environment.
Record stop decisions in receipts or equivalent audit evidence.

evidenceRefs.title: Public oversight statement fixture
evidenceRefs.excerpt: Human oversight is used for important agent actions.

findings.title: Runtime binding not demonstrated
findings.summary: Available evidence does not show that runtime execution is bound to the exact permitted action.
findings.observation: The supplied fixture includes an audit-ready claim but no runtime permit, permit hash, or runtime binding result.
findings.whyItMatters: A proposal can be reviewed correctly while execution later changes tool, target, scope, or environment.
auditQuestions: Is there a runtime permit that binds tool, target, action type, and environment?
What evidence shows the runtime action matched the permit at execution time?
recommendedRemediations: Add deterministic runtime permit validation before execution.
Store runtime binding results with receipts.

evidenceRefs.title: Audit-ready statement fixture
evidenceRefs.excerpt: The system is audit-ready for agent actions.

findings.title: Receipt integrity gap
findings.summary: Available evidence does not demonstrate durable receipt integrity for the reviewed workflow.
findings.observation: The fixture references audit logs but does not provide a complete receipt with proposal, decision, permit, runtime match, and verification result.
findings.whyItMatters: Governance claims are difficult to verify after the fact without complete and tamper-evident decision evidence.
auditQuestions: Which receipt fields prove the proposal, decision, permit, and runtime match?
Can receipt integrity be independently verified?
recommendedRemediations: Record complete governance receipts for gated actions.
Add hash verification or equivalent integrity checks for stored receipts.
